description.description: A series of four images from a video about football. In the first image, a referee in a black and white striped shirt gestures with his arm while surrounding football players move around him. The text 'Ref,' is displayed. In the second image, a man in a green jacket with a headset expresses frustration or passion with the text 'Thank you.' overlaid. In the third image, the same man in the green jacket is yelling and pointing as the text 'you get another 15.' appears. In the fourth image, a close-up of a football player in a helmet with tears in his eyes is shown with the text 'defend him.'
description.ocrText: 30 32 Ref, Thank you. you get another 15. defend him

tweetMedia.transcription: F*** that piece of crap. Hey, ref! Are you going to do something about this? He just kicked my boy in the head and he touched him! Thank you. I'm sportsmanlike conduct, Wingate! 15 yards! What? Shut up, you'll get another 15. This young man plays for my team, my team, and I will defend him like he's my own son against you or any other redneck son of a bitch! Don't worry, coach. I got your back. Coach ain't here to protect him now, is he? Ready? This team is your family, Michael. Go! Come back, come back, watch for him. He's got a hole! He's got a hole! Go! Go, Mike! Go, Michael! Go, Mike! Sorry, Coach. I stopped when I heard the whistle. Where were you taking him, Mike? To the bus. It was time for him to go home. Attaboy, Michael Orr. Attaboy!
